title: "Image Generation for Kenya"
output: html_document
date: "2025-06-25"

Plan of image generation:

# Identify Kenya rows from spreadsheet

# Join this with augmented dataset that has the affiliated attributes for each scenario pair
# Check join

# Generate new images based on these attributes

```{r Get Kenya rows}
library(tidyverse)
library(jpeg)

# Read in dataset of scenarios and assignments that exist
scenarioswithassignments <- read.csv("../scenario_dataset_with_assignments.csv")


# Assign the first 1500 that aren't already assigned to another group to Kenya
kenya <- scenarioswithassignments %>%
  arrange(respondent_ID) %>%
  filter(Assignment == "Unassigned") %>%
  slice_head(n = 1500) %>%
  mutate(
    Assignment = "Kenya"
  )

# Update the spreadsheet with the new Kenya assignments
scenarioswithassignments <- scenarioswithassignments %>%
  rows_update(kenya, by = c("respondent_ID", "image"))

write.csv(scenarioswithassignments, "scenario_dataset_with_assignments.csv")


# Now we want to augment the dataset with each scenario image pair's attributes
scenarios <- read.csv("../../Data Analysis/scenario_dataset.csv")
kenya_augmented <- left_join(kenya, scenarios, by = join_by(image == image)) %>%
  mutate(
    respondent_ID = coalesce(respondent_ID.x, respondent_ID.y)) %>%
  select(-respondent_ID.x, -respondent_ID.y, -choicenumber, -choicenumber2)

#Great, join looks good. Now change compensation to Ksh (0 Tsh -> 0 Ksh, 10,000 Tsh --> 500 Ksh)
kenya_augmented <- kenya_augmented %>%
  mutate(
    compensation_image.A = str_replace(compensation_image.A, "^(\\d+)Tsh\\.jpeg$", "\\1Ksh.jpeg"),
    compensation_image.B = str_replace(compensation_image.B, "^(\\d+)Tsh\\.jpeg$", "\\1Ksh.jpeg")
  )

# Convert to a long dataset
kenya_long <- kenya_augmented %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = ends_with(".A") | ends_with(".B"),
    names_to = c(".value", "alt"),
    names_sep = "\\."
  )

```

```{r Create image array output}

#For each choice set, create a stitched image with nothing in the top left, scenario 1 and scenario 2
#Next row is participants title, scenarioA participant level, scenarioB participant level
#And so on

# Number of rows and columns
num_rows <- 6
num_cols <- 3

createStitchedImage <- function(participantA, participantB, communityA, communityB, policyA, policyB, compA, compB, researchA, researchB, num) {

  # List of image filenames
  image_files <- c("blank.jpeg", "heading1.jpeg", "heading2.jpeg", 
                   "participant.jpeg", participantA, participantB, 
                   "community.jpeg", communityA, communityB, 
                   "policy.jpeg", policyA, policyB,
                   "comp.jpeg", compA, compB,
                   "research.jpeg", researchA, researchB)
  
  # Read images, handling missing files
  image_list <- lapply(image_files, function(file) {
    tryCatch(readJPEG(file), error = function(e) array(0, dim = c(100, 100, 3)))  # Default blank image if missing
  })

  # Get dimensions
  heights <- sapply(image_list, function(img) dim(img)[1])
  widths <- sapply(image_list, function(img) dim(img)[2])

  # Determine final width and height
  final_width <- max(widths)
  final_height <- max(heights)

  # Standardize image sizes
  standardized_images <- lapply(seq_along(image_list), function(i) {
    img <- image_list[[i]]
    h <- dim(img)[1]
    w <- dim(img)[2]
    blank_img <- array(1, dim = c(final_height, final_width, 3))
    start_h <- floor((final_height - h) / 2) + 1
    start_w <- floor((final_width - w) / 2) + 1
    blank_img[start_h:(start_h + h - 1), start_w:(start_w + w - 1), ] <- img
    blank_img
  })

  # Arrange images into a grid
  stitched_img <- array(0, dim = c(num_rows * final_height, num_cols * final_width, 3))
  for (r in 1:num_rows) {
    for (c in 1:num_cols) {
      idx <- (r - 1) * num_cols + c
      if (idx <= length(standardized_images)) {
        stitched_img[((r - 1) * final_height + 1):(r * final_height), 
                     ((c - 1) * final_width + 1):(c * final_width), ] <- standardized_images[[idx]]
      }
    }
  }

  # Save output
  output_filename <- paste0("stitched_output_", num, ".jpg")
  writeJPEG(stitched_img, output_filename)

  return(output_filename)
}
```


```{r Generate images for entire spreadsheet}

i = 1

kenya_long$image <- NA

while(i < nrow(kenya_long)) {
    Arow <- kenya_long[i,]
    Brow <- kenya_long[i+1,]
    participantA <- kenya_long[i, 8]
    participantB <- kenya_long[i+1, 8]
    communityA <- kenya_long[i, 10]
    communityB <- kenya_long[i+1, 10]
    policyA <- kenya_long[i, 12]
    policyB <- kenya_long[i+1, 12]
    compA <- kenya_long[i, 14]
    compB <- kenya_long[i+1, 14]
    researchA <- kenya_long[i, 16]
    researchB <- kenya_long[i+1, 16]
    outputnum <- kenya_long[i, 3]
    
    # Prints the same image for both rows that are associated with that choice
    kenya_long[i, 1] <- createStitchedImage(participantA, participantB, communityA, communityB, policyA, policyB, compA, compB, researchA, researchB, outputnum)
    kenya_long[i+1, 1] <- createStitchedImage(participantA, participantB, communityA, communityB, policyA, policyB, compA, compB, researchA, researchB, outputnum)
    i <- i + 2
}


setpredrop <- kenya_long
```
